newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan to cut benzene content in gasoline from 2000.
newsitem.headline: Japan to cut benzene content in gasoline from 2000.

text.p: Japan will toughen restrictions on the amount of benzene, a cancer-causing chemical, allowed in gasoline from 2000, the Trade Ministry said on Wednesday.
Oil firms will need to modify refineries to keep the benzene content of gasoline under one percent by the end of 1999, it said. The current ceiling is five percent.
Many other Asian countries already limit the benzene content of gasoline to below five percent. Thailand does not allow more than 3.5 percent and Taiwan limits it to three percent.
